role: Exploratory factorial follow-up on previously inspected routes; no held-out superiority claim
status: Combination and analysis fixed before its navigation outcomes were inspected
shared: Reuse saved teaching/probe images and wiring checkpoints from the mechanism study. Keep all pooling, standardisation, spiking, memory, scan, movement, stopping and scoring settings unchanged. Rerun original, Sobel and Ardin-style references and demand exact trajectories and steering scores.
primary_descriptive_endpoint: Whole-trajectory mean route deviation including failures, equally averaged over routes and seeds; lower is better.
inference: Paired crossed route/seed bootstrap intervals and exact route-mean sign-flip tests conditional on five seeds. One Holm family of 12 contrasts: three candidates versus each of three references (original, Sobel, Ardin-style), combined versus each single change, and the factorial interaction. Report all outcomes, route/seed effects and leave-one-route-out sensitivity. Completion and probe outcomes are descriptive.
interaction: combined - oriented - linear + original in cm; negative means the combined deviation reduction exceeds the sum of the two separate reductions on this scale. This is a behavioural interaction, not evidence for a cellular mechanism.
stop: Complete all 240 trials regardless of rankings, with no retuning and no automatic default change.

candidates.oriented_form: Retain hex averaging and local adaptation; replace the form bank with Gaussian sigma=1 (5x5) followed by signed Sobel x/y/magnitude. Original colour unchanged.
candidates.linear_colour: Original form unchanged; colour is rectified G-B/B-G after existing hex averaging, omitting pre-opponency tanh.
candidates.oriented_linear: Combine exactly the form stream from oriented_form and colour stream from linear_colour.

limitations: Eight routes in one synthetic environment; five wiring seeds are crossed technical repeats. Routes and separate-variant results were previously inspected. Ardin-style refers only to adapted image preprocessing, not a reproduction of the original full Ardin model.
